root_text: China is currently experiencing a surge in cases of human metapneumovirus (HMPV), a respiratory virus that causes infections in the lungs and airways. This surge has led to overcrowded hospitals and the implementation of emergency measures.

China is currently experiencing a surge in cases of human metapneumovirus (HMPV), a respiratory virus that causes infections in the lungs and airways. This surge has led to overcrowded hospitals and the implementation of emergency measures.
